 Shri N.S. Solanki - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This first bail application under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.354/2024 dated 07.08.2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali Sohagpur, District Shahdol (M.P.). for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2)(n) and 506 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 12.08.2024.
2.

As per the prosecution story, 30 years' old prosecutrix lodged FIR alleging that she knew Abhimanyu since 2014 and she was living with him for the last 10 years and in this period, she conceived on number of occasions but all times, he administered medicines causing miscarriage.
It is alleged that on 24.07.2024 she came to know that Abhimanyu is already married and having wife.
As such, he has exploited her for last 10 years and now he has refused to keep her with him.
FIR was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.

sentences.text: a false FIR has been lodged.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed grant of bail.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it a fit case for grant of bail.

Consequently, this first bail application under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Abhimanyu Baiga be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS,
2023.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
